cases.name: c1vis.static_3d_neighborhood_generated
cases.claim: the 3-D neighbourhood figure exists in raster and vector form with sane dimensions
cases.expected: PNG and SVG present, both dimensions above 400 px

cases.name: c1vis.worldline_figures_generated
cases.claim: every required worldline, interception and clock figure exists

cases.name: c1vis.earth_and_ship_sky_figures_generated
cases.claim: both apparent-sky figures exist, one per observer frame

cases.name: c1vis.aberration_animation_generated
cases.claim: the aberration and Doppler sky animations exist

cases.name: c1vis.journey_animation_generated
cases.claim: the journey, communication-delay and neighbourhood-rotation animations exist

cases.name: c1vis.contact_sheets_generated
cases.claim: every animation has a contact sheet, so a regression is visible without opening a video

cases.name: c1vis.animation_manifest_valid
cases.claim: every manifest entry carries codec, resolution, frame rate, frame count, duration and three checksums, and the animation actually moves

cases.name: c1vis.visuals_derived_from_saved_output_only
cases.claim: no visualization source recomputes a trajectory, aberration, Doppler shift, catalogue propagation or light-time solve
cases.expected: zero physics recomputation in the visualization tree
cases.note: the visuals read solver CSVs and draw them; this case is what keeps that true as the tree grows

cases.name: c1vis.no_blank_or_nonfinite_frames
cases.claim: no contact sheet is blank, and no nonfinite value reached a renderer
cases.note: records.column refuses NaN and infinity at the read boundary, so a nonfinite value fails loudly instead of vanishing from a plot

cases.name: c1vis.deterministic_rerender_metadata
cases.claim: re-rendering from the same input reproduces the plotted numbers and the figure metadata exactly
cases.expected: identical plotted CSV and identical metadata
cases.computed: plotted CSV sha256 matches; metadata matches
cases.note: image hashes are NOT compared: they are pinned to matplotlib and freetype versions, and the requirement allows pixel hashes only in a pinned environment. The plotted numbers are the invariant
